nodes.name: ThinkBubble

nodes.name: lifecycleToColumn

nodes.summary: Reconstructs the chronological sequence of todo snapshots across a message history for timeline playback.

nodes.name: buildAgentOrgTaskTimeline

nodes.name: buildTodoKanbanTimeline
nodes.summary: Combines message-derived and org-task-derived timelines into a single unified todo timeline.

nodes.name: TodoKanban
nodes.summary: Top-level React component rendering the todo Kanban board, including column layout, timeline scrubber, and per-todo cards.
